title: Error
description: Body of every 4xx and 5xx response from the merchant API and the guest status API.

type.description: Broad class; one per HTTP status family (see API-CONTRACT.md section 4).

code.description: Stable machine-readable code from the table in API-CONTRACT.md section 4. New codes may be added.

message.description: Human-readable. May change; do not parse.

param.description: The request field at fault, if any.

request_id.description: Also sent as the SecurePay-Request-Id header. Quote it when asking for support; it is the correlation ID in the audit log (FR-TXN-16).
